html:
What is beautiful about traveling to Da Nang in August is a question that many tourists are interested in, especially those who are coming to the coastal city for the first time, where not only are there famous landscapes, events, and exciting festivals, but visitors can also enjoy famous specialties in the autumn weather.

Da Nang welcomes visitors with beautiful landscapes such as Ba Na, Cu Lao Cham, Ngu Hanh Son or poetic beaches, besides there are also special festivals taking place all year round. However, if this is your first time coming to Da Nang, you will surely wonder what is beautiful about Da Nang in August, to answer that question, let’s find out the detailed content right below today.

The climate in August is relatively cool, it is a destination for travel enthusiasts, although Da Nang often has showers in August, the rain is not too long, so you should check the weather before coming here.

Da Nang is often divided into two distinct seasons, which are the dry season and the rainy season, the rainy season is from August to December, the dry season is from January to July.

If you do not want the hustle and bustle, the crowds, you should not travel to Da Nang in the summer from March to June, this is the peak season of Da Nang, so at the scenic spots you often have to queue and wait quite a long time, and the service costs are also high. If you travel to Da Nang on your own, you should proactively book tickets and rooms early to avoid being out of rooms.

Traveling to Da Nang in the low season from August to December, at this time Da Nang often enters the rainy season, however, you should check the weather in advance to still have a beautiful tour, and this is the low season so the services are often lower, and the scenic spots you also have to queue.

Activities taking place in August in Da Nang

Da Nang International Marathon

Traveling to Da Nang in August, visitors will be able to participate in the Marathon, this is an opportunity for visitors to exercise, challenge themselves and experience the exciting game in the coastal city.

B’estival Beer Festival

This is one of the big festivals taking place on the top of Ba Na, the festival takes place from April 30 to August 31, coming here on this occasion, visitors will join in the atmosphere of the festival with the sun in the music and enjoy giant bottles of beer and rich cuisine.

Helio Summer Festival

The festival takes place at Helio Center night market with many exciting activities, visitors will enjoy many dishes, or fresh seafood dishes, enjoy checking in at the Mediterranean film studio, participate in games with prizes at the carnival game area, … and many interesting games.

Places to visit when traveling to Da Nang in August

Linh Ung Pagoda

Da Nang has 3 pagodas with the same name in one city, Linh Ung Son Tra Pagoda has a majestic statue of Bodhisattva Guanyin, a spiritual tourist destination that many tourists visit.

Ngu Hanh Son

Coming here, visitors will encounter 5 mountains: Kim Son, Moc Son, Thuy Son, Hoa Son and Tho Son, of which Thuy Son is a large limestone mountain and is a tourist destination visited by many tourists, this is also an indispensable destination in the Da Nang tour itinerary.

Da Nang Sky Well

A virtual living spot that many tourists visit, especially those who travel to Da Nang in groups or groups can camp overnight right next to Sky Well to enjoy the cool breeze, and chat about thrilling stories together.

Da Nang Beach

Traveling to Da Nang, the first destination is the sea, the beaches in Da Nang include My Khe Da Nang beach, Non Nuoc Da Nang beach, Bac My An, Nam O beach, … tourists not only immerse themselves in the clear blue water but also participate in exciting games, such as paddle boarding, jet skiing, etc.

The indispensable dishes when traveling to Da Nang are: fresh seafood, grilled spring rolls, Quang noodles, Da Nang vermicelli with fish sauce, pork rolls, Da Nang pancakes, Da Nang beef noodles, Da Nang fish noodles … with the rich flavor of Ha Thanh.

So with the experience of traveling to Da Nang in August that Vietlook just shared above, we hope it will be helpful for your trip, wish you a happy vacation in the coastal city of Da Nang.
